newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST -- Czech Republic -- Jan 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST -- Czech Republic -- Jan 10.

text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The average inflation rate for the whole of 1996 reached 8.8 percent, which was lower by 0.3 percentage points than compared to the previous year.

- The publicised contest for a strategic investor in Aero Vodochody will be announced around January 20 and should be concluded by the first half of April. The cabinet appears to prefer Czech Airlines and Boeing, who want to enter into the company collectively.
- Constant delays in the execution of the proposal for housing politics are causing tenants to doubt the cabinet's capability to resolve the country's housing problems.

MLADA FRONTA DNES - Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus announced after a meeting with Polish Prime Minister Wlodzimierez Cimoszewicz that the Czech Republic and Poland have decided to join their strengths towards securing membership in NATO.
- Economic experts conclude that massive privatisation of state businesses in 1996 slowed at the end of the year because of the cabinet's inability to decide on privatisation of certain companies.

PRAVO - Parliamentary representative and chairman of the parliament budgetary committee, Jozef Wagner, recently removed from the Social Democratic Party caucus for voting against the party's position on the budget, will return to the party in a district organisation in Teplice.
- By the end of January, Finance Minister Ivan Kocarnik should arrange a meeting of economic ministers to propose measures which would enable investment funds to convert to open-end funds.
- Recent data from the Czech Statistical Bureau from autumn 1996 shows that 4 percent of Czechs have a second job, which is 10 percent less than in the autumn of 1995.
